items.question: How long is the grace period dependents get to obtain a new UAE residence permit after their sponsor's residence visa expires or is cancelled?
items.gold: Dependents are granted a 6-month grace period from the date of expiry or cancellation of their visas.
items.fact: Dependents get 6-month grace period after sponsor visa cancellation.

items.question: For how many years can a foreign spouse, parent or child of a UAE citizen get a UAE residence visa without having to work in the UAE?
items.gold: 5 years, with the UAE citizen as the sponsor.
items.fact: UAE citizen's foreign family members get 5-year residence visa.
